title: Native tests fail when quarkus.package.type=uber-jar
body:
**Describe the bug**
Using a brand new project, adding the property `quarkus.package.type=uber-jar` to the `application.properties` so to create an uber jar, the native tests fail to start the native image for an IOException. 

```
[INFO] Running org.acme.getting.started.NativeGreetingResourceIT
Executing [/home/jrota/vagrant/bionic64/issues-reproducers/uber-jar-native-tests-fail/target/uber-jar-native-tests-fail-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT-runner, -Dquarkus.http.port=8081, -Dquarkus.http.ssl-port=8444, -Dtest.url=http://localhost:8081, -Dquarkus.log.file.path=target/target/quarkus.log]
[ERROR] Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 1, Skipped: 0, Time elapsed: 0.112 s <<< FAILURE! - in org.acme.getting.started.NativeGreetingResourceIT
[ERROR] org.acme.getting.started.NativeGreetingResourceIT  Time elapsed: 0.111 s  <<< ERROR!
org.junit.platform.commons.JUnitException: Quarkus native image start failed, original cause: java.io.IOException: Cannot run program "/home/jrota/vagrant/bionic64/issues-reproducers/uber-jar-native-tests-fail/target/uber-jar-native-tests-fail-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT-runner": error=2, No such file or directory
Caused by: java.io.IOException: Cannot run program "/home/jrota/vagrant/bionic64/issues-reproducers/uber-jar-native-tests-fail/target/uber-jar-native-tests-fail-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT-runner": error=2, No such file or directory
Caused by: java.io.IOException: error=2, No such file or directory

[INFO] 
[INFO] Results:
[INFO] 
[ERROR] Errors: 
[ERROR]   NativeGreetingResourceIT » JUnit Quarkus native image start failed, original c...
[INFO] 
[ERROR] Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 1, Skipped: 0
```
The only workaround I found was to create a new default profile to create the uber jar so that the native profile stays clean (see https://github.com/kiegroup/kogito-apps/pull/597/commits/950c7f1123c086889a176c623fc1052092463d7b ). 

**Expected behavior**
The native tests should not fail? 

**Actual behavior**
I guess that the property
```
<properties>
        <quarkus.package.type>native</quarkus.package.type>
</properties>
```
is somehow ignored and the native tests try to use the uber jar as well? 

**To Reproduce**
```
mvn io.quarkus:quarkus-maven-plugin:1.10.5.Final:create \
    -DprojectGroupId=org.acme \
    -DprojectArtifactId=uber-jar-native-tests-fail \
    -DclassName="org.acme.getting.started.GreetingResource" \
    -Dpath="/hello"
cd uber-jar-native-tests-fail
mvn clean verify <- no native tests are executed, ok
mvn clean verify -Pnative <- native tests are executed, ok
```
Add `quarkus.package.type=uber-jar` to `application.properties` and then 
```
mvn clean verify -Pnative <- crash
```
See the exception above

Link to a small reproducer (preferably a Maven project if the issue is not Gradle-specific).

https://github.com/r00ta/issues-reproducers/tree/main/uber-jar-native-tests-fail

Or attach an archive containing the reproducer to the issue.

Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Create a new application
2. Add `quarkus.package.type=uber-jar` to `application.properties`
3. run `mvn clean verify -Pnative`

**Configuration**
```properties
quarkus.package.type=uber-jar
```

(If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.)
